Date : 04.04.2026 Heard Mr. T. Laskar, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Also heard Mr. B.
Sharma, learned Addl. P.P appearing for the State.

The four accused/petitioners, namely Ebadur Rahman, Khalilur Rahman, Mojibur Rahman @
Mujibur Rahman and Wahida Begum @ Wahida Khatoon are invoking the powers under Section 528 of BNS.

The four petitioners herein are seeking quashing of the criminal proceeding being Special (POCSO) Case No. 66/2024 (arising out of Lanka P.S Case No.91/2023 u/s 376 IPC r/w section- 9/11 of the Prevention of Child Marriage Act, 2006 & r/w section 4/17 of the POCSO Act,
2012 and pending before the Court of the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Hojai at the state of appearance.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the FIR was lodged on 03.02.2023, by the respondent No.2, as informant, making allegations of child marriage with regard to the petitioner No.4 in this petition but the facts of the case are denied and that it is denied that any such child marriage took place for that the girl was married off at all to the person Page No.# 3/3 concerned.

It is further submitted that vide order dated 07.01.2026, that a petition was filed before the learned Trial Court by the petitioner No.1 herein who is the main accused seeking representation through Advocate on that day was rejected..
The NBW is pending with regard to the said petitioner No.1.
The steps of notice shall be taken.
A copy of the petition may be furnished to the prosecution.
Steps of notice shall be taken upon respondent No.2 through the office of the learned Addl. Public Prosecutor, Assam, and to be executed through the concerned police station.

It is submitted and undertaken on behalf of the petitioner No.1 that he will appear before the learned Trial Court and desires to participate in the proceedings and that earlier he was in Kerala with regard to some occupational activities.

Also call for the scanned TCR of this case from the concerned learned court below Special Judge,
Hojai.
Page No.# 1/3 vs The State Of Assam And Anr on 4 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39062641/
2 I have given my due consideration to the matter.
I have also heard the learned Additional P.P appearing for the State.

The execution of the NBW issued against the petitioner No.1, Ebadur Rahman vide order dated 07.01.2026 shall remain stayed subject to the condition that the said petitioner Ebadur Rahman shall appear before the learned Trial Court on the next and consequent dates and he shall not hamper or tamper with the witness.
List this matter again on 13.05.2026.
